description: This file defines accessibility-related functions and classes for Firefox within the Playwright project, including a function to retrieve the accessibility tree and a class representing accessibility nodes.

classes.name: FFAXNode
classes.description: Represents an accessibility node in Firefox, providing methods to analyze and serialize accessibility tree nodes.

methods.name: getAccessibilityTree
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the full accessibility tree for a given session and optional element handle, returning the tree and a found node if applicable.
